title: Presidential Candidates Face Hectic Friday Schedule
subtitle: Debates, visits, and meetings shape the agenda for candidates vying for the Palácio do Planalto
excerpt: This Friday, presidential candidates will engage in live debates, Q&A sessions, interviews, visits to markets and neighborhoods, and meetings with the industrial sector.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On Friday, presidential candidates' schedules are packed with activities spanning various communication formats and direct engagement with society.

Debates, Q&A Sessions, and Interviews

Candidates will participate in live debates, Q&A sessions, and interviews granted to media outlets, allowing voters to follow their proposals and positions in real-time.

Visits to Markets, Neighborhoods, and the Industrial Sector

In addition to media appearances, the schedule includes visits to markets and neighborhoods, as well as meetings with representatives of the industrial sector, reinforcing the candidates' presence in various economic and community spheres.

Involvement in Social Projects

Presidential candidates also have a meeting scheduled at a social project, demonstrating interest in initiatives that seek direct impact on the lives of the population.

With information from Agência Brasil.
